links.comparator_used: AI segmentation without human review (fully automatic AI volumetry)
links.outcome: Accuracy of tumor growth detection (false positive and false negative rates) from longitudinal volumes
links.effect: AI without human review gave similar results but with a 25% false positive rate and an 8.33% false negative rate. AI with physician review detected growth a median of 21 months earlier than visual inspection in the clinical progression group.
links.tradeoff: Physicians spent a median of 2 minutes reviewing, revising and approving each AI segmentation.
links.quote: AI without human review generated similar results but with a 25% false positive and an 8.33% false negative rate.
